tests.name: aggregate-session
tests.quote: `APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(<열>)`을 SELECT 목록과 ORDER BY에 쓸 수 있는 집계 항목으로 더한다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)

tests.name: value-session
input: CREATE TABLE ints (day INT, value INT)
CREATE TABLE words (day INT, value STRING)
CREATE SKETCH numbers ON ints (value) BY day PRECISION 4
CREATE SKETCH strings ON words (value) BY day PRECISION 4

tests.name: daily-session
tests.quote:
`CREATE SKETCH <이름> ON <테이블> ( <값 열> ) BY <날짜 열> PRECISION

`는 원본 테이블의 값 열에 대한 일별 스케치를 만든다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
CREATE SKETCH early ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 5
CREATE SKETCH later ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 5

tests.name: period-session
tests.quote: `ESTIMATE <이름> FROM <시작 일자> TO <끝 일자>`는 일별 스케치의 기간을 조회한다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
CREATE SKETCH daily ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 4

tests.name: group-session
tests.quote: WHERE를 통과한 각 그룹의 NULL 아닌 열 값을 4.1~4.5로 집계한다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
SELECT day, GROUPING(day), APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user), COUNT(*) FROM visits GROUP BY ROLLUP(day)
SELECT day, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits WHERE day < 0 GROUP BY CUBE(day)
SELECT day, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user), APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((day), ())

tests.name: ordering-session
tests.quote: ORDER BY에서 두 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT 값은 3.2대로 여섯 자리로 반올림한 값을 수로 비교한다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
SELECT day, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits GROUP BY day ORDER BY APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) DESC
SELECT day, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits GROUP BY day ORDER BY APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user), day DESC LIMIT 3

tests.name: precision-session
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
CREATE SKETCH p4 ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 4
CREATE SKETCH p5 ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 5
CREATE SKETCH p6 ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 6

tests.name: precision-report
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
CREATE SKETCH p7 ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 7
CREATE SKETCH p10 ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 10
CREATE SKETCH p12 ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 12

tests.name: definition-session
tests.quote: 문법에 맞는 CREATE SKETCH는 이름이 이미 쓰이면 `ERR EXISTS`, 원본 테이블이 없으면 `ERR NO_TABLE`, 값 열·날짜 열 순서로 처음 없는 열이 있으면 `ERR NO_COLUMN <열>`, 날짜 열이 INT가 아니면 `ERR TYPE`, p가 4~12가 아니면 `ERR PRECISION`의 순서로 확인한다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
CREATE AGGREGATE totals AS SELECT day, COUNT(*) FROM visits GROUP BY day
CREATE SKETCH visits ON nope (missing) BY absent PRECISION 0
CREATE SKETCH totals ON nope (missing) BY absent PRECISION 0
CREATE SKETCH fresh ON nope (missing) BY absent PRECISION 0
CREATE SKETCH fresh ON visits (missing) BY absent PRECISION 0
CREATE SKETCH fresh ON visits (user) BY absent PRECISION 0
CREATE SKETCH fresh ON visits (user) BY user PRECISION 0
CREATE SKETCH fresh ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 3
CREATE SKETCH fresh ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 13
CREATE SKETCH fresh ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 12

tests.name: catalog-session
tests.quote: 테이블, 사전 집계, 일별 스케치는 이름 공간을 함께 쓴다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
CREATE SKETCH daily ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 4
CREATE AGGREGATE daily AS SELECT day, COUNT(*) FROM visits GROUP BY day
CREATE SKETCH daily ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 4
CREATE AGGREGATE other AS SELECT day, COUNT(*) FROM daily GROUP BY day
CREATE SKETCH other ON daily (user) BY day PRECISION 4
CREATE AGGREGATE totals AS SELECT day, COUNT(*) FROM visits GROUP BY day

tests.name: query-session
tests.quote: `APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(<열>)`을 SELECT 목록과 ORDER BY에 쓸 수 있는 집계 항목으로 더한다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
SELECT APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits ORDER BY APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(day)
CREATE AGGREGATE bad AS SELECT day, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits GROUP BY day
CREATE AGGREGATE bad AS SELECT missing, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits GROUP BY day
CREATE AGGREGATE bad AS SELECT day, SUM(user), APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits GROUP BY day

tests.name: command-session
tests.quote: 새 명령도 명령어, 토큰과 문법, 의미 확인 순서로 처음 걸린 오류 한 줄만 출력한다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
CREATE SKETCH daily ON visits (day) BY day PRECISION 4
CREATE SKETCH x ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 007
CREATE SKETCH x ON visits user BY day PRECISION 4
CREATE SKETCH x ON visits (user) BY day

tests.name: loading-session
tests.quote: 정의할 때 이미 있는 행과 정의 뒤 성공한 INSERT·COPY의 행을 모두 반영한다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
CREATE SKETCH daily ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 4

tests.name: planning-session
tests.quote: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT가 SELECT 목록에 있는 질의는 3단계 사전 집계로 답할 수 없다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (day INT, user STRING)
CREATE AGGREGATE totals AS SELECT day, COUNT(*), COUNT(user) FROM visits GROUP BY day
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT user), APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits
CREATE SKETCH daily ON visits (user) BY day PRECISION 4
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT user), APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits WHERE day < 1
SELECT APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits WHERE day < 1
SELECT day, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(user) FROM visits WHERE day < 1 GROUP BY day

tests.name: generated-session
tests.quote: 앞 단계의 입력 한계와 검사 범위를 유지한다.

tests.name: scale-session
tests.quote: 새 대규모 테스트는 INT 날짜 열과 STRING 값 열이 있는 테이블에 COPY로 1,000,000행을 넣는다.
